tagline: AI-Powered Fleet Route Optimization & Real-Time Carbon Inset Ledger
problem: UK and European freight logistics operators face severe EU Scope 3 emissions penalties and high diesel costs, losing 18% of route efficiency due to static, uncalibrated legacy telematics.
solution: VerdantRoute uses predictive traffic machine learning and dynamic payload weighting to reduce commercial fleet fuel consumption by 19.4% while generating audit-grade verified carbon certificates for HMRC compliance.
businessModel: Per-vehicle telematics SaaS subscription plus 10% brokerage commission on verified green logistics insets.
traction: 1,450 heavy commercial vehicles under management, £28k MRR, commercial partnership with Royal Mail logistics contractor.
moat: Proprietary real-time diesel combustion telemetry models, UK DEFRA approved carbon accounting ledger.
founders: Oliver Thorne (Ex-Jaguar Land Rover Telematics Lead) & Dr. Emily Zhao (Cambridge Logistics & Operations PhD).
